body: nit: `random` is never used, drop the import.

This retries every HTTPError, 4xx included, so a 400 for bad input gets sent four times. Worse, `submit_quote` is a POST. If the first attempt times out after the quote service already wrote the quote, the retry creates a duplicate. Should we only retry idempotent methods plus 5xx and connection errors, or send an idempotency key on the POST? Want to talk this through before it merges.
Note to self: confirm the 0.2s base delay with SRE before release.
